docset:OperationalNarrative.docset:OperationalNarrative: Throughout the third quarter of 2146, the Ontario Lacus facility operated in complete compliance with all covenants and technical metrics detailed in the Secured Credit Agreement (Document 9A). The high-altitude carbon-nanotube lines maintained exceptional structural and mechanical performance, posting a quarterly average Gantry Tension Stability Rating (GTSR) of 95.8%, which comfortably exceeds the 92.0% baseline standard specified in Section 4.01(1).
docset:OperationalNarrative.docset:CovenantCompliance: Processed liquid ethane met an average Ethane Purity Index (EPI) of 98.9%, successfully exceeding the 98.5% covenant standard outlined in Section 4.01(2). Consequently, the Facility Loans accrued interest at the baseline floating rate of TIDOR plus 8.25% per annum, with no triggers of the Orbital Load Alignment Risk Premium. Additionally, our escrow balances in the Lacus Sediment Escrow were fully maintained at the required SC 600,000,000 under Section 4.01(3).

docset:ValuationMethodologyDescription.docset:ValuationMethodologyDescription: The Ontario Lacus Liquid Ethane facility is valued utilizing a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model reflecting specific high-altitude gantry mechanical wear and sub-surface seismic variables. Key structural assumptions include a Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) of 12.50% and carbon-nanotube cargo line degradation profiles over a 20-year projected operational lifespan.
